messages:
maria: kicking off discussion — onboarding 'redwood-llm-3.0' canary. Observed eval: +0.4% ROUGE-L vs baseline, latency +12ms p95. Propose rollout gating w/ hysteresis to avoid flapping. See suggested config.

josh: nit — 0.4% reg is small, what's CI? Also what's sample size on the eval set?

maria: eval set N=5k queries; bootstrapped CI ~ ±0.35%. also A/B traffic sample 2k sessions over 6h.

anya: share the proposed gating rules pls.

maria: paste config:
```
canary:
  duration: 2h
  min_traffic: 2%
  max_traffic: 20%
  step: 5%
  metrics:
    - name: quality.delta_rouge_l
      threshold: -1.0%
      comparator: greater_or_equal
    - name: p95_latency.ms
      threshold: +50
      comparator: less_or_equal
  hysteresis:
    window: 30m
    required_consecutive: 2
  fallback: "route->baseline-v2"
```

lee: question: comparator signs confusing. Also threshold semantics: quality.delta_rouge_l threshold -1.0% meaning allow up to -1% drop? suggest express as max_regression 0.01.

maria: yep can rephrase. intent: allow at most 1% regression and still progress; if regression beyond that -> immediate rollback.

eval-bot: A/B results uploaded: baseline vs redwood-llm-3.0-quant8
 - quality.delta_rouge_l: -0.8% (p=0.04)
 - p95_latency: +85ms
 - cost_per_token: -34%

josh: p=0.04 — borderline. With p95 +85ms that's above p95 threshold if threshold +50ms. Might auto-fallback.

anya: propose relax latency threshold to +120ms if cost saving >30% and quality reg <1.0% ? That trades latency for cost.

maria: we prefer strict latency on low-latency routes (chat-interactive). For background batch endpoints we can be laxer. Suggest per-route gating.

lee: add route tag in config: routes: [chat, batch]

maria: updated quick patch:
```
canary:
  per_route:
    chat:
      max_latency_delta_ms: 50
      max_quality_regression_pct: 0.5
    batch:
      max_latency_delta_ms: 150
      max_quality_regression_pct: 1.5
```

josh: also need to define minimum successful sample size before evaluating stats (e.g., N>=1000) and smoothing for noise.

maria: +1. propose stats_min_n: 800 and smoothing EWMA alpha 0.2 in gating logic.

deploy-bot: canary started for redwood-llm-3.0-quant8 -> 2% traffic at 2026-03-19T14:03:20Z

anya: let's monitor first 30m; if any route breaches, auto-fallback should trigger and notify #eng-oncall.

lee: add oncall mention in config: notify_channels: ["eng-oncall", "eng-ml"]

maria: will open PR with gating DSL + unit tests. Thanks everyone :rocket:

josh: one more: include rollback cooldown 1h to avoid thrash.

maria: added. I'll tag deploy when PR's ready.

eval-bot: smoke test summary after 45m: chat route p95_latency +92ms (breached chat threshold), quality.delta_rouge_l -0.6% (within chat threshold) -> ACTION: auto-fallback triggered to baseline-v2. Rollback completed at 2026-03-19T14:50:10Z :white_check_mark:

anya: good exercise, saves flapping. We'll capture logs for RCA.

maria: will attach eval logs and PR link in follow-up.
